summary: The recorded base reproducibly corrupts either cached GLM-5 fused-MLA shard when a marked RunAI tensor view shares a reused staging buffer. The exact candidate makes retained marked tensors owned clones in the actual Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration.load_weights path. Its regression, independent reverse-order and marker-boundary cases, existing RunAI loader tests, and a gfx950 numerical check pass from repository sources.

tests.what_was_measured: Actual GLM-5 load_weights fused-q/kv cache behavior with marked views into one overwritten CPU staging buffer. q-then-kv produced [3,4,3,4] and kv-then-q produced [1,2,1,2], reproducing corruption; the unmarked alias boundary behaved as expected.
Candidate regression through Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration.load_weights: both shard orders and ordinary unmarked tensors; 3 passed.
Independent adversarial staging-buffer reuse in both shard orders plus an unmarked-tensor boundary; all exact values matched.
Existing RunAI marker, synchronous consumption, cloning, and loader boundary coverage after helper/constant refactor; 11 passed.
Candidate-produced fused [[1,2],[3,4]] weight on the assigned gfx950 GPU; multiplication by [[2],[-1]] exactly matched independent reference [[0],[2]].

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X, gcnArchName gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, executed the exact numerical fused-weight check; see evidence/candidate-gpu-probe.txt.

remaining_limitations: No GLM-5.3-Flash model or draft-model weights were available, so full-model semantic generation was not run.

Distributed RunAI Model Streamer, Kubernetes, TP=8, streamer concurrency=8, and DFLASH serving were not available; the issue's deterministic staging-buffer ownership contract was exercised directly instead.
Only one assigned gfx950 GPU was available, so no multi-GPU or multi-node claim is made.
No native sources changed in the candidate, repository-environment.json declares native null, and no native rebuild was applicable.
